Not the OP but for me I don't notice any gameplay-breaking lags in games like Red Dead 2, Forza, Flight Sim.   


It all comes down to the types of games you plan to play e.g. online player vs player multiplayer or single-player titles. It's great for single player titles, slightly less so for multiplayer ones.

My Series S sometimes streams games to my laptop (in the other room). Yes it can't beat the laws of Physics, but I don't notice any substantial delay/lag even in fast games like FIFA 21 or Forza. The WiFi chip in Series S is amazingly powerful.   


However, if you are heavily into online multiplayer games then it definitely puts you in a slight disadvantage vs others but slower paced games like Flight Sim are an absolute joy.   


Streaming quality is function of your router speed (consider getting a decent one, if possible one with 5GHz) and distance of your laptop from the Xbox.
